Specification: This module is a very small TLA+ specification used to define and contrast several simple operators over a single state variable y. It includes operators that directly mention the primed variable y', tuple constructors that depend on the current state, an ENABLED expression over a parameterized action, and a set expression mixing a primed argument with an unprimed one. The file does not define an initial condition, next-state relation, temporal specification, fairness condition, proof, or PlusCal algorithm; instead it appears intended to exercise or illustrate syntactic/operator classification behavior around priming and Leibniz versus non-Leibniz contexts.
